name: TGStat
description: Analyze Telegram channels, monitor post statistics, and search public Telegram publications via the TGStat API.
instructions:
## TGStat
This connector integrates with the TGStat API (`https://api.tgstat.ru`), the leading analytics and search database for Telegram channels and groups. It provides read-only tools to retrieve channel profiles, calculate audience and reach statistics, search across public Telegram publications in real time, and monitor post engagement.

## Authentication
1. Register an account and subscribe to an API plan at https://api.tgstat.ru.
2. Navigate to your TGStat API dashboard to generate your API access token.
3. Configure `TGSTAT_API_TOKEN` with your token. The connector automatically authenticates every request by passing this token in the `token` query parameter (`QUERY_AUTH`).

## Identifiers
- **Channel Identifier (`channelId`)**: Accepted formats include channel usernames with or without '@' (e.g., `@telegram` or `telegram`), full Telegram channel links (e.g., `t.me/telegram`), or internal numeric TGStat channel IDs.
- **Post Identifier (`postId`)**: Accepted formats include full public post URLs (e.g., `t.me/telegram/123`) or internal TGStat numeric post IDs.

## Pagination & Limits
- The `tgstat_search_posts` tool supports pagination using `limit` (number of records, between 1 and 50, default 20) and `offset` (record offset, starting at 0, maximum 1000).
- TGStat enforces rate limits and quota allocations according to your purchased API tier. When quotas or rate limits are exceeded, the API returns HTTP 429 or an error status object.

## Common Workflows
- **Channel Profile & Auditing**: Retrieve basic metadata and subscriber size with `tgstat_get_channel_info`, then query `tgstat_get_channel_stats` to inspect reach, citation index, and engagement metrics.
- **Content Monitoring**: Search for brand mentions or trending keywords across public Telegram channels using `tgstat_search_posts`, then inspect high-performing publications with `tgstat_get_post_stats`.

## Limitations
- This adapter is strictly read-only and does not publish messages or modify Telegram channels.
- Private Telegram channels and chats are not accessible unless explicitly indexed by the TGStat platform.

TGSTAT_API_TOKEN.label: API Token
TGSTAT_API_TOKEN.help: Your TGStat API access token obtained from https://api.tgstat.ru.

verifyHints.401: TGStat rejected the API token. Please verify that TGSTAT_API_TOKEN is active and copied correctly from api.tgstat.ru.
verifyHints.403: Access denied. Ensure your TGStat subscription tier grants access to this endpoint.
verifyHints.429: TGStat rate limit reached. Please wait before retrying.

tools.name: tgstat_get_channel_info
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive profile information and metadata for a Telegram channel or chat including title, subscriber count, and category.

channelId.description: Channel username (e.g. '@telegram' or 'telegram'), invite link ('t.me/telegram'), or TGStat channel ID.

tools.name: tgstat_get_channel_stats
tools.description: Retrieve analytical metrics and performance statistics for a Telegram channel such as reach, engagement rate, and publication counts.

channelId.description: Channel username (e.g. '@telegram'), channel link, or internal TGStat channel ID.

startDate.description: Start timestamp (Unix epoch in seconds) for filtering channel statistical data.

endDate.description: End timestamp (Unix epoch in seconds) for filtering channel statistical data.

tools.name: tgstat_search_posts
tools.description: Search for Telegram posts matching keyword queries across public channels and chats with filtering by peer type, language, and date.

q.description: Search query or phrase to find in Telegram post text (e.g. 'artificial intelligence').

limit.description: Number of posts to return (between 1 and 50, default is 20).

offset.description: Pagination offset for search results (default is 0, maximum is 1000).

peerType.description: Type of peer to search: 'channel', 'chat', or 'all' (default is 'all').

startDate.description: Filter posts published on or after this Unix timestamp in seconds.

endDate.description: Filter posts published on or before this Unix timestamp in seconds.

language.description: Two-letter ISO language code to filter posts (e.g. 'en', 'ru').

tools.name: tgstat_get_post_stats
tools.description: Retrieve performance metrics and engagement statistics for a specific Telegram post including views, shares, comments, and reactions.

postId.description: Post identifier or direct public post URL (e.g. 't.me/telegram/123').
